scheme_name: Incentive given to Encourage Inter caste Marriages
other_conditions: Both spouses must be permanent residents of Maharashtra.
One spouse must belong to the Savarna, Hindu Lingayat, Jain, or Sikh community.
The other spouse must belong to Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Vimukta Jati (tribe), Nomadic Tribe, or Special Backward Class.
Male spouse must be at least 21 years old.
Female spouse must be at least 18 years old.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 payable as a joint draft to both spouses.
